title: Initial Build Offer · Big Balder Brand ↔ Conquistadors

analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand (Retool) targets elite RB Jonathan Taylor (C-AVI 93.0, D-AVI 94.7) and TE Isaiah Likely (C-AVI 81.2, D-AVI 85.2) from Champion Favorite Conquistadors. To pry Taylor away from a title favorite without compromising Conquistadors' championship pursuit, Big Balder Brand uses TE1 overall Trey McBride (C-AVI 94.8, D-AVI 92.9) as the centerpiece, paired with 21-year-old RB Jeremiyah Love (C-AVI 69.7, D-AVI 90.6) and a 2028 2nd-round pick. This proposal provides Big Balder Brand a premier RB1 anchor to pair with Nico Collins and Jayden Daniels, while supplying Conquistadors the elite tight end upgrade they lack plus long-term RB upside and draft liquidity. Market Reality scores this offer at 72% acceptance probability (Realistic).

submitted.summary: Big Balder Brand surrenders TE1 overall Trey McBride, 21-year-old RB Jeremiyah Love, and a 2028 2nd-round pick to acquire Jonathan Taylor and Isaiah Likely. Conquistadors secures the consensus TE1 overall in McBride (+13.6 C-AVI upgrade over Likely) and adds elite young RB asset Jeremiyah Love (90.6 D-AVI) to cushion the loss of Taylor.

title: Initial Shop Assets · Big Balder Brand ↔ Conquistadors

analysis.executiveSummary: Shopping Trey McBride (TE, C-AVI 94.8, D-AVI 92.9) to the Conquistadors fails current Market Reality standards. Big Balder Brand's strategic Rebuild mandate requires acquiring premium draft capital (1st/2nd round picks) or top-tier young talent in exchange for an S-tier dynasty cornerstone. However, authoritative league records confirm the Conquistadors have traded away all of their 2027, 2028, and 2029 1st, 2nd, and 3rd round draft picks. Furthermore, as a 'Win Championship' contender, the Conquistadors cannot yield core starters like Bijan Robinson, Jonathan Taylor, or Puka Nacua without jeopardizing their own title odds. Because no package between these two specific franchises can satisfy both organizational goals or achieve an Acceptance Probability threshold of 70%, no trade is recommended.
